ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: <image1> is a map of the distribution of annual precipitation and the zoning of annual average temperature in Qinghai Province, and the figure uses Roman numerals to mark the three temperature zones I, II, and III. Among them, temperature zone II is mainly located in the relatively low-lying basins or river valleys in the northern and northeastern parts of the figure, and temperature zone III appears in areas such as the eastern and southeastern parts that are more strongly affected by higher terrain or mountains. Then reason: the question asks to compare the annual average temperature of temperature zone II and temperature zone III. Qinghai Province is located on a plateau, and in the same region annual average temperature is obviously affected by elevation; low-lying basins and river valleys usually have higher temperatures, while high-elevation mountains have lower temperatures. Therefore, the annual average temperature of temperature zone II is higher than that of temperature zone III.
